title: Maren's Winter Report
offer: Agent, the Council asked which ailments are most common for the winter budget — so I sent them my logs. All of them, names and streets and every illness by hearth.
opener: HERALD — Maren sent the Council a map of every sick villager by name and address, just to answer "how much cough syrup to buy." They needed a COUNT; she gave them a CONFESSION — fix the pipeline before winter.
debrief: Shape data at the source: aggregate what serves the purpose, drop what only creates risk. Minimize by transforming, not just by cutting.
